question: Find the full names of members who attended a non-fundraiser event with more than 20 attendees and incurred an expense linked to one of the top three budget entries with the highest spent amounts in the 'Advertisement' category.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m."XCL_035", m."XCL_036"
FROM member AS m
WHERE m."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT a."XCL_002"
    FROM attendance AS a
    INNER JOIN event AS e ON a."XCL_001" = e."XCL_010"
    WHERE e."XCL_013" <> 'Fundraiser'
      AND e."XCL_010" IN (
          SELECT a2."XCL_001"
          FROM attendance AS a2
          GROUP BY a2."XCL_001"
          HAVING COUNT(*) > 20
      )
)
AND m."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT ex."XCL_022"
    FROM expense AS ex
    WHERE ex."XCL_023" IN (
        SELECT b."XCL_003"
        FROM budget AS b
        WHERE b."XCL_004" = 'Advertisement'
        ORDER BY b."XCL_005" DESC
        LIMIT 3
    )
)

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m."XCL_035" || ' ' || m."XCL_036" AS full_name
FROM member AS m
INNER JOIN attendance AS a ON m."XCL_034" = a."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN event AS e ON a."XCL_001" = e."XCL_010"
INNER JOIN budget AS b ON e."XCL_010" = b."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN expense AS ex ON b."XCL_003" = ex."XCL_023"
WHERE e."XCL_013" != 'Fundraiser'
  AND b."XCL_004" = 'Advertisement'
  AND e."XCL_010" IN (SELECT a2."XCL_001" FROM attendance AS a2 GROUP BY a2."XCL_001" HAVING COUNT(*) > 20)
  AND b."XCL_003" IN (SELECT b2."XCL_003" FROM budget AS b2 WHERE b2."XCL_004" = 'Advertisement' ORDER BY b2."XCL_005" DESC LIMIT 3)
